answer: Every claim climbs the marble of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the grove re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short. Reaching the sable of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. The design leans on web-of-trust with decaying edges, unlocked only after continuous uptime, no identity may audit its own recruit. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name.
